body:
# Crystal Ore Mod

Crystal Ore is a simple Minecraft mod that adds a brand-new ore to the game.
This crystal ore is stronger than netherite, making it a powerful resource for players who manage to obtain it.

The ore is extremely rare and generates deep underground, encouraging exploration and mining.

## Features

* Adds a new crystal ore
* Very rare generation
* Stronger than netherite
* Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
